reasoning: The pipeline's rule is that a shown result closes the work and the human's own eye is never the gate on an ordinary delivery. A row whose definition of done names his eye is only describing one of the three cases rule 12/27 reserve for him — a taste call, a trade-off no artifact settles, or a still-open change to the definition of correct. None of those holds: no part of the result is a matter of preference, the page shows what the plan holds and nothing else, so nothing is left for him to decide. It is an ordinary buildable result that a command, a test and a plain read already confirm was delivered — the board page regenerates from PLAN.md, every declared row appears under its own state, tests/test_board_matches_the_canon.py passes against the generated page, and the rendered surface itself was opened and renders as described, which is the surface the receipt owes for a done naming a page. The verification is not the producer's self-report alone but the artifact read on the real page, so the checkpoint closes in the same step the result is shown. If he disagrees after looking, that disagreement is a new fact and its own task; the closed row stays closed.
